intents.title: Group tag value changes
intents.reason: Upstream groups tag changes per tag key/value; we group elements by their whole set of tag changes (changesetElements.ts), a deliberate different design.

intents.title: Min browser support in vite/tsc instead of browserslist
intents.reason: Our browserslist is load-bearing: vite.config.js derives build.target from it, and tsconfig targets ES2025 on purpose.

intents.title: Fix rerender bug in filters map
intents.reason: Our location map is declarative and reads current props through useEffectEvent (src/components/filters/location.tsx), so the stale closure cannot happen.

intents.title: Fix active changeset detection in sidebar
intents.reason: We derive the active row from the TanStack route match with a numeric id (src/views/changesets_list.tsx).

intents.title: Clickable URLs in changeset sources
intents.reason: Changeset tag values are linkified in the changeset menu.

intents.title: Rearrange changeset details table
intents.reason: Replaces their property carousel, which we never had; our tags table lives in the changeset menu.

intents.title: Improve text contrast
intents.reason: Two text labels still used zinc-400; raised to zinc-500. The rest of their CSS targets markup we do not have.

intents.title: Filter descriptions say what they filter for
intents.reason: Filter descriptions reworded to "Filter for changesets ...".

intents.title: Tweak the changeset info panel tab bar
intents.reason: Restyles their floating tab strip; our review column/sheet has no such tab bar.

intents.title: Show selected element in tag and geometry tabs
intents.reason: DetailsChanges highlights the selected element and opens its group (isSelected, revealInGroup).

intents.title: Fix empty Modified Relations section
intents.reason: Our element grouping has no type filter and lists modified relations with the modify group (changesetElements.ts).

intents.title: Enter submits on watchlist page
intents.reason: Our watchlist add control is a form with a submit button (src/components/user/watchlist_user.tsx).

intents.title: Disable view-changesets button for empty watchlist
intents.reason: The link is disabled with an explanation when the loaded watchlist is empty.

intents.title: 404 page
intents.reason: defaultNotFoundComponent with a Page not found view.

intents.title: Redirects from /:id and /changeset/:id
intents.reason: Legacy osmcha.org URLs; our route tree never had those paths.

intents.title: Contrast of read/selected rows in the list
intents.reason: Stronger selected row; read state persisted in localStorage for 30 days instead of component memory (decided by Tobias).

intents.title: Accessibility of the changeset list
intents.reason: aria-current on the open row and a label on the list; no ID as accessible name (decided by Tobias).

intents.title: Dashed underline on <time> in changeset panel
intents.reason: CSS for their tab panel; our times sit in tooltips with their own affordance.

intents.title: Changeset comment styling
intents.reason: Restyles their comment paragraph; ours is a blockquote with its own empty state.

intents.title: Remove line truncation in changeset list
intents.reason: Our list does not clamp the comment (src/components/list/primary_line.tsx).

intents.title: MapLibre 6
intents.reason: We were already on MapLibre 6 with setWorkerUrl; adopted their worker.format es.

intents.title: Area filter UI and Nominatim usage
intents.reason: Encode the query; search after each word or on Enter, at most one request per second, instead of typeahead (decided by Tobias). Their layout change we already had.

intents.title: Overpass only after explicit confirmation
intents.reason: Missing adiff offers "Load from Overpass" instead of an automatic fallback; no Overpass retries (decided by Tobias).
